pitch: I'm a software engineer and business owner who builds complete products and keeps them running: websites, platforms, payment systems, AI agents and the automation behind them. Over the last decade I've shipped 25+ sites and services, rebuilt a live payments program across five processors, led a sales team, and turned an Amazon data-analysis job into tooling other analysts used every day. Give me a problem or a rough idea and I'll deliver the whole thing: design, code, deployment and support.

seeking.label: Honestly, open to anything
seeking.detail: Title and level are negotiable. The team, the problem and the chance to own something matter more than the label.
